The core node of this workflow is Face AutoFit Single @ CHAOS. 
Face AutoFit Single @ CHAOS is an intelligent facial adaptation node that automatically detects faces and adjusts the portrait's position, size, and angle according to different modes, ensuring it meets professional composition standards.

## Main Parameter Description
- mode: Composition mode selection (Portrait/Upper Body/Full Body/Custom)
- background: Background color (White/Grey), can be set arbitrarily without affecting output quality
- move_x/move_y: Subject - Horizontal/Vertical position fine-tuning
- face_size: Facial size adjustment
- angle: Free rotation angle adjustment for the face
- detection_method: Facial detection method, default dlib is sufficient

## Mode Encoding System
The mode_code output by the node is an integer that includes automatic gender recognition and composition mode information:
- 0-3: Female
  - 0: Female Portrait Mode
  - 1: Female Upper Body Mode
  - 2: Female Full Body Mode
  - 3: Female Custom Mode
- 4-7: Male
  - 4: Male Portrait Mode
  - 5: Male Upper Body Mode
  - 6: Male Full Body Mode
  - 7: Male Custom Mode
This code can be connected to Prompt Selector Single @ CHAOS.Used for automatically selecting different prompts or processing flows based on gender and composition patterns. The author has pre-set some examples of prompts, and it is recommended to adjust and modify them according to personal preference styles.

## Modes
- Portrait mode 
- Half-length mode 
- Full-length mode 
- Custom mode 

## Usage Tips
- For portraits that require accurate gender recognition, it is recommended to use the insightface detection method.
- If the size and position of the face need adjustment, you can reduce face_size or adjust move_x/move_y.

If the three preset modes do not meet your needs, you can choose custom mode and manually adjust various parameters.

这个工作流的核心节点是Face AutoFit Single @ CHAOS 
Face AutoFit Single @ CHAOS 是一个智能人脸适配节点，能自动检测人脸并根据不同模式调整人像位置、大小和角度，使其符合专业构图标准。

## 主要参数说明
- mode ：构图模式选择（肖像/半身/全身/自定义）
- background ：背景颜色（白色/灰色）  随便设置不影响出图效果
- move_x/move_y ：人物-水平/垂直位置微调
- face_size ：人脸大小调整
- angle ：人脸自由旋转角度调整
- detection_method ：人脸检测方法，默认insightface即可

## 模式编码系统
节点的 mode_code 输出的是一个整数，包含自动性别识别和构图模式信息：
- 0-3 ：女性
  - 0：女性肖像模式
  - 1：女性半身模式
  - 2：女性全身模式
  - 3：女性自定义模式
- 4-7 ：男性
  - 4：男性肖像模式
  - 5：男性半身模式
  - 6：男性全身模式
  - 7：男性自定义模式
这个编码可以连接到Prompt Selector Single @ CHAOS，用于根据性别和构图模式自动选择不同的提示词或处理流程。作者已预设了部分提示词的示例，建议大家根据自己喜好风格进行调整和修改。
